events.title: Scenario: AI model buildouts amplify data-center electrical load in urban load pockets
events.summary: AI-driven compute growth concentrated in data-center clusters could create localized distribution stress and accelerate demand for transformers and substation work. Procurement lead times and utility upgrade prioritization will determine near-term reliability outcomes.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer manufacturing lead times remain a chokepoint for substation upgrades
events.summary: Persistent manufacturing and material constraints may keep transformer lead times elevated, complicating substation upgrade schedules and increasing reliance on interim measures.

events.title: Scenario: Substation automation rollout raises operational technology exposure
events.summary: Substation automation can improve reliability and visibility but increases OT/IT integration risks, requiring parallel investment in cybersecurity and systems engineering.

events.title: Scenario: Renewable curtailment risk from constrained transmission corridors
events.summary: If renewables additions outpace transmission capacity, curtailment rates may climb, creating stress on project economics and increasing demand for storage and grid flexibility investments.

events.title: Scenario: Lithium and critical-mineral pressure from EV and storage demand
events.summary: Competition for lithium and processing capacity could delay battery projects and elevate costs, creating cross-sector impacts for storage, EVs, and grid flexibility deployments.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC linkage demand rises with offshore wind and long-distance transfers
events.summary: Growing HVDC demand driven by offshore and distant renewables may strain specialized manufacturing and EPC capacity, affecting transmission project schedules.

events.title: Scenario: Targeted grid-resilience funding may accelerate prioritized transmission and substation projects
events.summary: Policy-driven resilience funding could accelerate selected grid upgrades, affecting procurement and vendor allocation while altering project timing across regions.

events.title: Scenario: AI-enabled predictive maintenance adoption increases for substations
events.summary: AI-enabled predictive maintenance could improve reliability and optimize capital deployment, but benefits depend on data integration, sensor coverage, and operational adoption.

events.title: Scenario: Geopolitical concentration in refining capacity could shift supply dynamics
events.summary: Concentration of processing capacity introduces systemic supply risk for batteries and downstream manufacturing; diversification and resilient sourcing are potential mitigations.

events.title: Scenario: EPC and contractor capacity pinch points as multi-domain projects ramp
events.summary: Parallel growth in transmission, substation, and storage projects can create EPC capacity constraints that propagate delays and cost pressure across sectors.
